summary: {person} proposes giving the commission chair authority to act for the full body in an emergency.
realLife: Carter called for a stronger NRC chair with the ability to choose key staff and act for the commission when urgent decisions arose.
gates: A commission is considering who may act between meetings.
weights: A longer interval before the next meeting favors a temporary delegation.
inGame: needs: the scope of an acting chair's authority.

turns.what: The commission keeps decisions with the full body.
turns.pulledBy: Members can assemble before the decision is due.
turns.writesBack: The vote records each member's position.

turns.what: The chair may speak for the commission only until it meets.
turns.pulledBy: The members delegate authority for an interim period.
turns.writesBack: The delegation ends at the meeting.
